sum_insured.description: Sum insured (indemnity) or benefit amount per trigger event (parametric) this premium buys.

alternatives.description: Covers with room for that premium, and what makes each useful.

beyond_capacity.description: The same shortfall measured on the plan's capacity; equals `unallocated`.

placed_beyond_need.description: Premium the default places beyond what the customer can use now.

unallocated.description:
Plan price no split can place: the remaining covers' limits are full, for example after a
postponement (R41). Above zero, the customer may change plan or cancel without penalty
before the period starts; no plan is suggested (R42, R45).

Alternative.description: Room for more premium in one cover of the plan.

can_take.description: The most extra premium the cover can take this period.

exposure.description: What makes the extra cover usable: declaring it (a trip, a ticket, a device).

shadow.description: A candidate factor, rated in shadow only (R43).

withheld.description: Not disclosed or not consented: rated at the undeclared group average (R33).

Exposure.description:
What a customer must have for a cover to protect them this policy period. The optimiser
places usable premium only where there is exposure (R42).

of.description: For declared items and upcoming events: registered kinds; a parent covers its subtree.

ExposureKind.description:
How a cover finds whom it protects. The engine computes the customer's need differently for
each form; the kinds of items and events are registered in `config/exposure_types.yaml` (R55,
ADR-005).

oneOf.description: A declared item of a registered kind, with its value.
An upcoming event of a registered kind in the policy period, after the waiting period.

Money.description: Money in minor units (cents). No floating point in money paths (R29).

Rate.description:
Premium per unit of sum insured, in parts per million: 1,000,000 = premium equals the sum
insured. Finer than `Bps` because micro-cover rates are small (ADR-004).

Schedule.description: The covers and sums insured for one policy period. Allocations are ordered by cover id.

need.description: The sum insured this customer can use this period; zero means no exposure.

description:
The optimiser's suggested allocation: product information under the insurer's licence, with
the factors behind it (R49). The customer can change any part of it (R34).
title: Suggestion
